titulo_fr: Lire une étiquette sanitaire : Repérer les informations
titulo_es: Read a health label: Find data
intro: Look for indication, warning and circumstance of use on an information label. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Look for indication, warning and circumstance of use on an information label. It separates the fact of its context: the verbal times, connectors and powers indicate when and who provides each data.
Attention point: Impersonal constructions and object pronouns require what to do or avoid. In this fragment, «étiquette» means «label».

frases.fr: L'étiquette précise que ce produit peut provoquer une légère somnolence chez certaines personnes.
frases.es: La etiqueta precisa que este producto puede provocar somnolencia leve en algunas personas.
frases.en: The label states that this product may cause mild somnolence in some people.

frases.fr: Il est conseillé de le prendre le soir, sauf indication différente d'un professionnel.
frases.es: Se aconseja tomarlo por la noche, salvo que un profesional indique otra cosa.
frases.en: It is advisable to take it at night, unless a professional indicates otherwise.
